the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: fppf sheaf property of T -> H^0(T, H^0(Lg^*K)) via flat-pullback commutation and fpqc descent of quasi-coherent sheaves; etale localization reduces to B affine; module translations realize K by a pseudo-coherent complex of A-modules whose fibres have no H^{-1}; the cut-in-two lemma splits M^bullet into a perfect tau_{>=0} part of tor amplitude [0, b] and a negative part, and in case (2) the negative part vanishes making K perfect; replacing K by tau_{>=0}K, the bounded free representative is K-flat, so the functor computes as the kernel of a map between free O_B-modules, i.e. a linear fibre product of affine spaces, representable by an explicit finitely presented affine scheme (source lines 672-798)
